summary: Adversarial run over the v2 route of Phase 1 at 358e8bfde. 61 new cases in packages/architecture-enforcement/src/__tests__/architecture-v2-route-adversarial.test.ts attack the four risk targets: the review-record gate, the v2 ratchet, the reconcile CLI input (owner, rationale, plan hash, budget), and the CI step string. 60 cases pass and pin the intended behavior. 1 case fails and exposes one real defect: --budget-s accepts a 400-digit value that Number() maps to Infinity, so budgetSeconds is not a positive whole number of seconds (spec FR-8.1) and the run ignores its time budget. A second, non-exploitable weakness is recorded as a finding: the review gate finds the staged manifest by the replacement id 'reconciliation-manifest' only, so a preview that stages the same manifest path under a renamed id skips the gate; the apply pipeline still refuses such previews before any write. No production file was edited. The red case routes to Green.
nonblocking_findings: F1 (defect, route to Green): parsePinRefreshArguments accepts a --budget-s value that Number() maps to Infinity. parsePinRefreshArguments(["--budget-s", "9".repeat(400)], ...) returns { budgetSeconds: Infinity } instead of throwing, because the regex /^[1-9]\d*$/ accepts any digit run and line 124 of packages/architecture-enforcement/src/architecture-pin-refresh-cli.ts converts with Number(value) without a finiteness or magnitude bound. Spec FR-8.1 (plan.md task 1.4b) says the value must be 'a positive whole number of seconds'; Infinity is not one, and a run with budgetSeconds=Infinity never stops at its budget, which defeats the PM 30-minute cap that FR-8 exists to enforce. Severity is low: a large finite value such as 999999 already lets an operator bypass the budget procedurally, so this is a contract violation, not a new capability. The committed red case budget_rejects_a_value_that_is_not_a_finite_whole_number fails at HEAD and goes green when the parser rejects values whose Number() is not a finite whole number (or caps the value at a stated maximum).

F2 (hardening, no write bypass reachable): the review-record gate assertReviewedStagedDelta (packages/architecture-enforcement/src/architecture-reconciliation.ts:1214-1227) finds the staged manifest only through the replacement id 'reconciliation-manifest' (stagedManifestFromPreview, :1180-1191). A preview that stages the same manifest destination path and the same unreviewed candidate delta bytes under a renamed id ('v2-manifest', or a known id such as 'ownership-map') skips the gate. Probe evidence: applyArchitectureReconciliation with the canonical id rejects with 'V2 reconciliation refuses a staged baseline delta without a review record', while the same bytes under 'v2-manifest' or 'ownership-map' reject later with 'Policy-aware reconciliation requires the committed artifact family', proving the gate layer was passed. The write never completes for such previews: the fresh-preview equality check (architecture-reconciliation.ts:1281-1295) and validateCommittedDocument (:1141-1173), which validates each committed document by replacement id, both refuse doctored plans before bytes land. Recommended hardening: key stagedManifestFromPreview on the manifest destination path (V2_RECONCILIATION_DESTINATION_PATHS[0]) instead of only the replacement id. The committed case renamed_replacement_id_cannot_complete_a_write pins the end-to-end refusal.

The one failure is budget_rejects_a_value_that_is_not_a_finite_whole_number (finding F1). No other case fails and no case fails for a syntax or import error.

Gate probe (tsx, same worktree): id=reconciliation-manifest -> rejected with 'V2 reconciliation refuses a staged baseline delta without a review record'; id=v2-manifest -> rejected with 'Policy-aware reconciliation requires the committed artifact family'; id=ownership-map -> the same later rejection. The gate keys on the replacement id (finding F2).

The ratchet cases pass: v2_check_fails_a_new_production_finding reports status=debt-change with additions=1 for a tracked file importing @reading-advantage/db under --policy v2; v2_check_stays_clean_for_reviewed_baselined_debt reports clean after the finding is baselined with owner and rationale; v2_check_fails_a_second_new_finding_besides_baselined_debt reports additions=1 naming only the new file with removals=0; v2_check_ignores_a_manifest_that_stages_the_new_finding stays debt-change although a manifest at the v2 path stages the finding as a baselineAddition. The comparison counts only reviewed baseline files, so the manifest cannot mask a live finding.

The gate matrix passes: removals-only and renames-only staged deltas without reviews are refused with the gate message; a non-array reviews field is refused; a capitalized acceptance status 'Accepted' is treated as candidate and refused; v1 previews (no policy field, or policyVersion 'v1') are refused with 'Reconciliation writes require the exact accepted v2 policy'; a wrong expected plan hash is refused; the unacknowledged path forwards acknowledge=false to the transaction; applyArchitectureReconciliationForPolicy authorizes only the exact ordered four-path v2 set with policy 'v2' and refuses swapped order, a missing path, policy 'v1', and the capitalized 'V2'.

The reconcile CLI contract passes: createUpdatedArchitectureBaselines refuses the owner values 'Daniel', 'Monorepo Architecture', 'monorepo/architecture', 'monorepo.architecture', 'monorepo!', and '--acknowledge' before any write, and accepts 'monorepo-architecture', 'monorepo_arch', and '0wn3r-1d'; the rationale bounds hold at 11 refused, 12 accepted, 1000 accepted, 1001 refused, and whitespace-only refused; the parser refuses five malformed --expected-plan-hash values (uppercase, 63, 65, non-hex, prefixed), the unpaired --acknowledge and --expected-plan-hash forms, four invalid --policy forms, and the unpaired or valueless --owner/--rationale forms.

The CI string cases pass: the 'Architecture boundary check' step holds exactly one run line equal to 'run: pnpm architecture:check --skip-input-snapshot-pin --policy v2'; the 'Build architecture check inputs' step builds @reading-advantage/backend and @reading-advantage/knowledge-space-core and precedes the boundary step; the workflow holds zero lines matching architecture:(pin:refresh|reconcile|baseline:update|transaction:recover) and zero architecture lines holding --acknowledge.
